title: feature-delta
description: Schema v1.1 for unified feature-delta.md — single source of truth per DD-D12 (US-INFRA-1). v1.1 (R1, US-11): Origin column annotation 'WAVE#rowN' supports row-level bijection check (E3b-row). Backward-compatible with v1.0 (Origin column optional).

WaveSection.description: A named wave section (DISCUSS, DESIGN, DISTILL, …) inside feature-delta.md.

name.description: Wave name — DISCUSS | DESIGN | DISTILL | DELIVER | DEVOPS | DISCOVER.

CommitmentRow.description: A single row in a wave commitments table (Origin | Commitment | DDR | Impact).

ddr.description: DDR (Design Decision Record) reference or 'n/a'. Legacy 'DDD' column accepted for back-compat (issue #50).

DesignDecision.description: A DDR (Design Decision Record) entry ratifying a design change (E3b, E5 ratification).

id.description: Decision identifier — DDR-N pattern. Legacy DDD-N accepted for back-compat (issue #50).

DDREntry.description: Alias for DesignDecision — DDREntry and DesignDecision are the same type.

DDDEntry.description: Legacy alias for DesignDecision (renamed to DDREntry, issue #50). Retained for back-compat.

title.description: Feature name from the first H1 heading.

wave_sections.description: Ordered list of wave sections present in the document.
